items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Miami: QB Malik Willis on IR (groin/abdomen, surgery possible); Kyle McCord starts, matches schedule. OUT last week - C Aaron Brewer, WR Chris Bell, CB Darrell Baker Jr. IR - RB De'Von Achane (season), DT Zach Sieler. QUESTIONABLE - DT Jordan Phillips (arm), C Andrew Meyer (stinger).

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Buffalo: QUESTIONABLE (from Week 10) - CB Christian Benford (groin), CB Dee Alford (concussion), LB Dorian Williams (calf). OUT - WR Tyrell Shavers (knee). IR - WR Joshua Palmer. Josh Allen starts.
